title: Workplace Posture Safety Guide
summary: This prompt creates a visual safety guide for correct desk posture to avoid back pain. It uses simple, clear figures with checkmarks and X-marks, suitable for universally understandable corporate training materials.
prompt: A visual safety guide for a workplace, illustrating the correct posture for sitting at a desk to avoid back pain. The infographic should show two figures: one in an incorrect, slouched posture with red X-marks, and one in a correct, ergonomic posture with green check-marks. The style should be simple, clear, and universally understandable, suitable for corporate training materials. –ar 3:4
